cancel_job.title: Cancel Job
cancel_job.description: Request cancellation of a queued or running job. Does not wait for terminal state.

extract_audio.title: Extract Audio
extract_audio.description: Enqueue an audio extraction job. Returns job_id immediately.

generate_thumbnail.title: Generate Thumbnail
generate_thumbnail.description: Enqueue a thumbnail generation job. Returns job_id immediately.

get_job.title: Get Job
get_job.description: Get one job snapshot including limited artifacts and error summary.

list_jobs.title: List Jobs
list_jobs.description: List media jobs with optional state filter and pagination (default take 20, max 100).

probe_media.title: Probe Media
probe_media.description: Probe a local media file with ffprobe. Synchronous read-only.

retry_job.title: Retry Job
retry_job.description: Create a new job from a failed, interrupted, or canceled job. Returns the new job_id immediately.

trim_video.title: Trim Video
trim_video.description: Enqueue a video trim job. Returns job_id immediately; use wait_job to observe completion.

wait_job.title: Wait Job
wait_job.description: Wait up to timeout_seconds (default 15, max 60) for a job terminal state. Timeout returns the latest snapshot and is not a job failure.
